_comment: Consensus: Praos, TPraos and PBFT, chain selection, the hard-fork combinator's state and history, header rules (module consensus). Its reference is ouroboros-consensus, and cardano-ledger for the protocol rules (cardano-protocol-tpraos). docs/design/correspondence-map.md says what an entry holds; scripts/check_correspondence.py checks it.

def consensus.ByronRulesConfig#windowThr.note: the threshold field of pbftWindowParams, for the configured signature threshold and a window its caller gives (ByronRules.update gives k, as pbftWindowSize does); the reference builds the window size and the threshold together from its configuration, and the floor into a Word64 is ByronRules.windowThreshold's, whose results the suite compares with values measured on GHC 9.10.3

def consensus.HardForkConfig#check.note: HeaderProtVerTooHigh is checked with the envelope here; the reference checks it in Conway's BBODY rule

def consensus.Praos2.State.newEpoch.note: the new-epoch branch of tickChainDepStatePolyPraos: the epoch nonce, the previous epoch nonce and the last epoch block nonce as the reference updates them, and the announcement cleared; the isNewEpoch decision is its callers' (Praos2.tick, and Praos.tick for a Praos2 state)

def consensus.state.EraHistory.perasRoun.note: the eraPerasRoundLength of each era's parameters, the per-era class method and constant merged into one function of the state layout (the Leios layout is one build's) and the era; no captured answer of the reference carries a Dijkstra round length yet, so the 90 slots are checked against the source only (LeiosBoundsSuite, LeiosBoundsEvidenceSuite's hand-derived GetInterpreter bytes)

def consensus.state.EraHistory.originLay.note: the Peras round of initBound only, by layout; the time, slot and epoch zero are the era history's (EraHistory.boundAt). The suite compares the genesis start's bounds with those of a state the Leios build wrote

def consensus.state.EraHistory.unrounded.note: the Peras round of mkUpperBound for an era of NoPerasEnabled; the suite compares the bound where Dijkstra starts, placed from Conway's start, with the first Dijkstra state the Leios build wrote

def consensus.state.EraHistory.upperLayo.note: the Peras round of mkUpperBound, its where clause (inEraEpochs by countEpochs, inEraSlots their product with the epoch size, both Word64, inEraPerasRounds the div by the round length) computed modulo 2^64 as the reference computes it; the branch of an era with rounds (Dijkstra) has no captured reference bound to compare with, only hand-derived cases (LeiosBoundsSuite)

def consensus.state.EraHistory.upperBoun.note: mkUpperBound whole: the slot the lower bound's plus inEraSlots modulo 2^64 (addSlots), the time the lower bound's plus those slots times the slot length, exact (addRelTime of a NominalDiffTime), the epoch as given and the round by upperLayout; the epoch size and slot length are given by the caller rather than an EraParams. EraStartSuite checks a wrapped bound against bytes derived from the source; as upperLayout, the rounds a Dijkstra end adds have no captured reference bound yet

def consensus.state.GenesisMirror.origin.note: the extended state's layout part at the chain's origin: the Leios build's Peras state of no epoch context and no certificate, which the captured Leios states hold (82 83 01 80 80 80); the 11.1 layout has none

def consensus.state.MirrorClock.interpre.note: reconstructSummary with the bounds of the state's layout: the past bounds and the current start from the telescope, the current era's end at the known transition or its safe zone, and the next era where the transition is known and the code has one, each computed by upperBound and safeZoneEnd with the reference's Word64 arithmetic; non-empty by construction (NonEmptyVector); no GetInterpreter answer of the Leios build has been captured, so its bytes are hand-derived (LeiosBoundsEvidenceSuite), and this node does not enter Dijkstra yet (#54)

def consensus.state.EraHistory.epochBoun.note: slotToEpochBound with the epoch size given rather than an EraParams; countSlots, the epochs + 1 and addEpochs are Word64, computed modulo 2^64

def consensus.state.EraHistory.safeZoneE.note: applySafeZone's StandardSafeZone case, with the era's parameters given one by one; no Cardano era has an UnsafeIndefiniteSafeZone in the summary the node answers with. QueryGoldenSuite compares GetInterpreter answers, whose ends it computes, with the reference node's

def consensus.state.EraHistory.unrounded.note: mkUpperBound of an era with no Peras rounds, the epoch size and slot length given rather than an EraParams: the slot modulo 2^64, the time exact, the round kept (Leios) or none (11.1). MirrorStep.startOf places an era entered after the start with it, as whenExtend does; LeiosBoundsEvidenceSuite compares that bound with the first Dijkstra state the Leios build wrote, QueryGoldenSuite the GetInterpreter ends with the reference node's

def consensus.DijkstraCrossing.forecastI.note: the Dijkstra forecast's three cases (the tip's own view, TICKF's view before the exclusive bound of the stability window past the tip's successor, OutsideForecastRange after it) as the reference's; the view holds only the fields header validation reads (Praos2.LedgerView), not the committee, the quorum or the transaction-byte bound. DijkstraHeaderRulesSuite validates the public testnet's headers after its ledger state at slot 2,168,639 against it, the leader check on that state's stake, and its exclusive bound

class consensus.AcquiredLeiosEbs.note: the youngest announcement slot of each acquired endorser block and its reverse index by slot; slots held as BigInt (the store's Word64 widened)

def consensus.AcquiredLeiosEbs#pruned.note: the immutable tip as an Option for WithOrigin

class consensus.LeiosBlockInfo.note: the two Leios fields of BlockInfo, biHasLeiosCert as LeiosCert and biLeiosAnnouncedEb as the announced endorser block's hash (the announcer's ElId and the size, which the gate does not read, are not kept); the node's processed forest keeps them in each block's DeliveredHeader beside its header, where the reference's VolatileDB keeps BlockInfo

def consensus.LeiosBlockInfo.of.note: the body's certificate (blockLeiosCert) and the header's announcement (headerLeiosAnnouncement) of a Dijkstra block, none for another era (Cardano/Block.hs:1605-1615); read from the block the fetched-block check decodes

def consensus.LeiosCertGate.hidden.note: the blocks ignoreUnacquiredCertRB and ignoreUnacquiredCertRBSuc hide, as a set the node's candidate construction excludes from the forest with the invalid ones (AvailableBlocks.candidates), where the reference wraps the forest's lookup and successor functions; both hide a block as a tip and as a successor

def consensus.LeiosCertGate.parkedOn.note: the certifying, not invalid, successors of the blocks announcing the endorser block, found by a pass over the forest where the reference reads its VolatileDB's announcer index (getLeiosAnnouncers)

class consensus.leios.StdGen.note: random's StdGen, a newtype over splitmix's SMGen: a seed and an odd gamma, the 64-bit words held in a Long's bits

def consensus.leios.StdGen#uniformR.note: uniformR on a 64-bit Int, with Long ends

class consensus.leios.LeiosJob.note: the offsets a NonEmptySet, since every job covers at least one transaction (mkLeiosJobPool)

class consensus.leios.LeiosJobState.note: the multiplicity an Int, as LeiosJobMultiplicity's

class consensus.leios.LeiosJobPool.note: IntMap and IntSet as SortedMap and NonEmptySet, in the same ascending order

def consensus.leios.LeiosJobPool#pickLea.note: the lowest bucket with an id not excluded, the index drawn by the reference's StdGen into its ids ascending

def consensus.leios.LeiosJobPool.of.note: the byte sum modulo 2^32 as the reference's Word32

type consensus.leios.BytesSize.note: a Word32 held in a Long, its sum and difference modulo 2^32

given consensus.leios.LeiosOrders.ebHash.note: PackedBytes 32's Ord, the unsigned lexicographic order of the bytes

given consensus.leios.LeiosOrders.ebPoin.note: the derived Ord: the slot, then the hash

def consensus.leios.PeerOffer#combine.note: the receiver is the newer offer, the left operand of the reference's insertWith

class consensus.leios.EbState.note: the onset a duration since the system start where the reference's RelativeTime has picoseconds; only the arrival's age reads it

enum consensus.leios.LeiosFetchRequest.note: the two constructors with the fields of LeiosBlockRequest and LeiosBlockTxsRequest

type consensus.leios.FocusedEbs.note: the MultiSet as positive counts by hash

class consensus.leios.LeiosOutstanding.note: over the peers' identifiers; the reference's PeerId newtype is the identifier itself

def consensus.leios.LeiosOutstanding#ann.note: the update recordAnnouncedEb makes under the lock, and whether it wakes the fetch loop; the lock and the wake are the caller's

enum consensus.leios.LeiosTxsReplyFault.note: the Left strings of the two checks as a closed type; the reference raises them with error and the peer loses its connection

def consensus.leios.LeiosFetchLogic.iter.note: the forecast's failure left generic, as only its Left is read

def consensus.leios.LeiosFetchLogic.prio.note: the prefix of Map.spanAntitone, the sum modulo 2^64 as the reference's Word64

def consensus.leios.LeiosFetchLogic.offs.note: a window and its mask as an Int and a Long's bits; the wire's Word16 and Word64 are the client's

def consensus.leios.LeiosFetchLogic.chec.note: the byte sum into a Word32 as the reference's fromIntegral

glue.reason: the instances of Praos2's state types that the chain-dependent state derives its equality, rendering and difference from, and the companions that hold them: Scala plumbing with no counterpart (#826)

the acquired-endorser-block gate's Scala plumbing with no counterpart of its own: the companions, the certificate's presence as an enum (biHasLeiosCert) and a block of the forest as the gate reads it (#54)

the Leios fetch state's Scala plumbing with no counterpart of its own: the companions, Word32's conversions and order on BytesSize, the MultiSet operations on FocusedEbs, the orders as Scala Orderings, the equalities, the job id's constructor, and the decision's result triple as a named record (#54)
